# thetalake_label (Resource)

The label resource allows for the creation and management of labels within Theta Lake.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thetalake_label" "example" {
  short_name       = "PII"
  long_name        = "Personally Identifiable Information"
  background_color = "#FF5733"
  hidden           = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `background_color` (String) RGB hex color value representing the background color of the label
- `long_name` (String) The description of the label
- `short_name` (String) The name of the label shown on records

### Optional

- `hidden` (Boolean) Indicates if the label is hidden on the UI

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The created timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `id` (Number) The label ID
- `org_unit_id` (Number) The org unit associated with the label
- `tagged_datums_count` (Number) The number of records with this label assigned
- `updated_at` (String) The updated timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user who created the label
